record - the long post-build write-ups, the lessons, the published history. This file is only the forward-looking list, so the scout and the builder can both read it. NOTE: the app's Content pipeline card still parses backlog.md, not this file (apps/chat/src/app.ts) - keep backlog.md's `- [ ]` / `- [~]` / `- [x]` markers exact until that is repointed.
origin  otto  = Otto asked for it (suggest.py). Always outranks an algorithmic candidate.
sweep = came out of a DataForSEO sweep and was accepted into the queue.
scout = proposed by next-content.py and accepted by Otto's 4pm reply.
status  queued | drafting | draft | published | dropped | blocked
priority  1 = next. Otto-origin items are inserted at 1 and push the rest down.
Seeded 3 Sep 2026 from the open items in backlog.md.
